values.summary: Implement the #493 GCP-D private platform foundation as static Terraform, operator runbook, retained proof packet, and issue-owned validation.
actual_changes: Added a GCP platform Terraform root with private custom-mode VPC, private subnet, IAP-only operator access, OS Login posture, explicit private egress, dedicated workload service account, separate storage-owner buckets, logging metric, and required labels.
Added a concise operator runbook for configuring, planning, applying, and destroying the private platform foundation without committing credentials or state.
Added retained GCP-D proof truth and repaired the issue-owned validator so configured IAP CIDR policy remains parameterized while still machine-checked.
